verse.verse_1: In the name of Allah, most benevolent, ever-merciful.
verse.verse_2: ALL PRAISE BE to Allah, Lord of all the worlds,
verse.verse_4: King of the Day of Judgement.
verse.verse_5: You alone we worship, and to You alone turn for help.
verse.verse_6: Guide us (O Lord) to the path that is straight,
verse.verse_7: The path of those You have blessed, Not of those who have earned Your anger, nor those who have gone astray.
